Version 4 is a complete rewrite. The short version:

🖥️ **It's a real app now.** A window with settings screens, instead of command-line flags you retyped on every launch. What you pick is saved, and it lives in the system tray while you play, so closing the window doesn't stop your presence.

✏️ **You control what Discord shows.** Every phase gets its own template, editable with a live preview.

🔄 **Updates install themselves.** This should be the last time you download an exe by hand.

Nothing from version 3 is gone: ranks, KDA and creep score, champion skins including the animated ultimates, TFT companions, Arena, spectating.

⚠️ **Coming from version 3?** Delete your old `leagueRPC.exe`, or the two will fight over the same Discord presence.
